facts.business: Kati Patang Lifestyle Limited operates in the alcoholic beverages sector, manufacturing and marketing premium chemical-free, gluten-free, and vegan beers in India, with international expansion through a UK brewery stake and a portfolio of imported wines and spirits via its subsidiary Agnetta International.

segments.name: UK Brewery Operations (Kati Patang Ltd, UK)

key_risks: Fragmented, high-fee state regulatory compliance frameworks
Lack of organized retail chains limiting shelf presence and display space
High taxation impacting margin structures (referencing TN case)
Complete prohibitions on direct alcohol advertising and DTC sales channels
Multi-tier local channels requiring navigation of capital-intensive, bureaucratic distributor networks
High upfront scale and capital deployment required to clear volume thresholds
facts.related_party_note: The company seeks approval for material related party transactions for FY 2026-27, including: (1) Unsecured loan receipt from Managing Director Gokul Naresh Tandan up to INR 10 crore; (2) Equity investment in subsidiary Empyrean Spirits Pvt Ltd up to INR 10 crore; (3) Loan grant/repayment with Empyrean Spirits Pvt Ltd up to INR 10 crore; (4) Loan grant/repayment with wholly owned subsidiary Agnetta International Pvt Ltd up to INR 10 crore; (5) Equity investment in UK subsidiary Kati Patang Ltd up to INR 10 crore; (6) Loan/interest transactions with any other related party as decided by Managing Director with Audit Committee approval, up to INR 10 crore per party.
